sentences.en: Grand Year (Tàisuì) at 午 Wǔ; Year-Breaker (Suìpò) at 子 Zǐ; Three Killings (Sānshà) at 亥 Hài, 子 Zǐ, and 丑 Chǒu.
Sitting-Killing (zuòshà) at 壬 Rén and 癸 Guǐ, Facing-Killing (xiàngshà) at 丙 Bǐng and 丁 Dīng; Floating-Heaven Void (fútiān kōngwáng) at 離 Lí and 壬 Rén.
sentences.enNote: 坐煞 (rear/sitting) and 向煞 (front/facing) are the two sub-groups in the parentheses; 坐煞/向煞/浮天空亡 are annual siting sha not in the glossary, rendered literally.

sentences.en: Inauspicious for opening the mountain (kāishān, siting the rear): the Year Overcoming the Mountains (nián kè shānjiā) — the 甲 Jiǎ, 寅 Yín, 辰 Chén, 巽 Xùn, 戌 Xū, 坎 Kǎn, 辛 Xīn, 申 Shēn, 丑 Chǒu, 癸 Guǐ, 坤 Kūn, 庚 Gēng, and 未 Wèi mountains; the Yin-Bureau Grand Year (yīnfǔ tàisuì) at 艮 Gèn and 巽 Xùn; the Six Harms (liùhài) at 丑 Chǒu; the Death Tally (sǐfú) at 亥 Hài; Moxa-Retreat (jiǔtuì) at 酉 Yǒu.
sentences.enNote: 開山=breaking ground on the sitting-mountain; 年尅(克)山家=the year's phase overcoming these mountain-sectors; 隂府太歲/死符/灸退 not in glossary, rendered literally.

sentences.en: Inauspicious for setting the facing (lìxiàng): the Mountain-Patrolling Rāhu (xúnshān Luóhóu) at 丁 Dīng; the Illness Tally (bìngfú) at 巳 Sì.
sentences.enNote: 巡山羅㬋 = 巡山罗睺, the eclipse-node demon Rāhu on mountain patrol; not in glossary.

sentences.enNote: 隂府太歲 prints （山乾）; 山 'mountain' is not one of the twenty-four points and is likely a copyist/OCR slip (the term takes two trigrams in every other chapter), so only 乾 Qián is rendered — flagged, not corrected.

sentences.en: Inauspicious for renovating a sector (xiūfāng): the Heaven-Office Tally (tiānguānfú) at 申 Shēn; the Earth-Office Tally (dìguānfú) at 申 Shēn; the Great Killing (dàshà) at 丑 Chǒu; the Grand General (dàjiāngjūn) at 酉 Yǒu; the Strongman (lìshì) at 午 Wǔ; the Silkworm Chamber (cánshì) at 乾 Qián; the Silkworm Officer (cánguān) at 巽 Xùn; the Silkworm Fate (cánmìng) at 辰 Chén; the Year-Punishment (suìxíng) at 巳 Sì; the Yellow Banner (huángfān) at 酉 Yǒu; the Leopard-Tail (bàowěi) at 丑 Chǒu; Fēilián (a swift wind-spirit sha) at 未 Wèi; the Mourning Gate (sāngmén) at 亥 Hài; the Condolence Guest (diàokè) at 亥 Hài; the White Tiger (báihǔ) at 未 Wèi; the Metal Spirit (jīnshén) at 巳 Sì, 寅 Yín, 卯 Mǎo, and 戌 Xū; the Solitary Fire (dúhuǒ) at 亥 Hài; the Five Ghosts (wǔguǐ) at 坤 Kūn; the Ruinous Five Ghosts (pòbài wǔguǐ) at 未 Wèi.
sentences.enNote: 修方=working a directional sector; almost all these annual sha are not in the glossary and are rendered literally. 歲刑 prints the non-directional glyph 已; emended to 巳 Sì (歲刑 takes a branch, and 已≈巳/己 in print) — an editorial reading, verify against source (conf lowered for this emendation).

sentences.enNote: 歲徳/歲徳合/歲枝徳 are auspicious annual spirits not in the glossary; 德=Virtue, 合=combination, 枝(=支)=branch.

sentences.en: the Yang Noble (yángguìrén) at 寅 Yín; the Yin Noble (yīnguìrén) at 午 Wǔ; the Year Prosperity-Star (suìlù) at 酉 Yǒu.
sentences.enNote: 貴人=noble/benefactor (cf. glossary 天乙贵人); 歲禄=the annual 禄 (Prosperity Star). Not in glossary, rendered literally.

sentences.en: the Year Horse (suìmǎ) at 亥 Hài; the Memorial Scribe (zòushū) at 乾 Qián; the Erudite (bóshì) at 巽 Xùn.
sentences.enNote: 歲馬 = the annual Traveling Horse (cf. glossary 驿马); 奏書 (memorial-presenting official) and 博士 (learned officer) are auspicious annual spirits, not in glossary.

sentences.en: the Cover-Mountain Yellow Way (gàishān huángdào): Greedy Wolf (tānláng) at 艮 Gèn and 丙 Bǐng; Great Gate (jùmén) at 巽 Xùn and 辛 Xīn; Military Arts (wǔqǔ) at 兌 Duì, 丁 Dīng, 巳 Sì, and 丑 Chǒu; Literary Arts (wénqǔ) at 離 Lí, 壬 Rén, 寅 Yín, and 戌 Xū.
sentences.enNote: 蓋山黄道=the 'cover-mountain' auspicious rota; the four star-names are glossary terms.

sentences.en: the Four-Advantage Three-Origins (sìlì sānyuán): the Sun (Tàiyáng) at 寅 Yín; the Moon (Tàiyīn) at 辰 Chén; the Dragon Virtue (lóngdé) at 申 Shēn; the Blessing Virtue (fúdé) at 戌 Xū.

sentences.en: Sitting-Killing (zuòshà) at 壬 Rén and 癸 Guǐ, Facing-Killing (xiàngshà) at 丙 Bǐng and 丁 Dīng; Floating-Heaven Void (fútiān kōngwáng) at 乾 Qián and 甲 Jiǎ.

The sitting-sha (rear-direction malign influence) at Gēng and Xīn (庚, 辛); the facing-sha (front-direction malign influence) at Jiǎ and Yǐ (甲, 乙); the Floating-Heaven Void (Fútiān Kōngwáng) at Kūn and Yǐ (坤, 乙).
sentences.enNote: 坐煞/向煞/浮天空亡 are named directional sha (malign influences) absent from the glossary; rendered literally. Per the parenthetical order, 庚辛 pairs with 坐煞 and 甲乙 with 向煞. 空亡 here is the directional-void sense of the 神煞 浮天空亡, distinct from the BaZi 旬空/空亡 (decade void) in the glossary.

sentences.en: Setting the facing — inauspicious: the Mountain-Patrolling Luóhóu (Xúnshān Luóhóu) at Wǔ (午); the Illness Token (Bìngfú) at Yǐ (乙).
sentences.enNote: 巡山羅㬋 = 巡山羅睺 Xúnshān Luóhóu, the mountain-patrolling Rāhu (eclipse node); 病符 Bìngfú, the sickness-token star. Both are named directional sha not in the glossary; 立向 = establishing the facing orientation.
